test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 26 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts and decide which conclusion(s) logically follow(s) from the given statements.

Statements:

Some tomatoes are apples.

All apples are mushrooms.

Conclusions:

(I) Some mushrooms are tomatoes

(II) All apples are tomatoes
solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/dcedd95a9f9ff9997412fc117cf50bcade1478a078552750f06aaa8d62f65f87.png] [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b298fb4fc457585a618d22492d98fb538c212f1bb02418772c7dc734bf87f1ba.png] 

Conclusions:

(I) Some mushrooms are tomatoes → Follows (As some tomatoes are apples and all apples are mushrooms. As some part of tomatoes is common with apples which whole comes in mushrooms, therefore it is true.)

(II) All apples are tomatoes → **Not** Follows (As some tomatoes are apples, but it does not mean that all apples are tomatoes., therefore it is False.)

∴ Here, Only conclusion (I) follows,​

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
